title: Platform capability stack
subtitle: Capability layers that turn infrastructure into a reliable product platform.

tiles.label: Cgroups & mounts
tiles.says: Linux caps resources and isolates filesystems.
tiles.detail: Control groups limit CPU and memory, and mount namespaces give each workload its own filesystem view. This makes density safe and noisy neighbours harmless.

tiles.label: Namespaces & routing
tiles.says: Namespaces isolate networks; routing moves packets between them.
tiles.detail: Network namespaces, veth pairs and ip_forward build private networks on one host. Teams get isolated environments without extra hardware.

tiles.label: Orchestration
tiles.says: Kubernetes orchestrates containers and keeps desired state.
tiles.detail: Controllers reconcile declared state, reschedule failed pods and roll out releases gradually. The business gets self-healing services and repeatable deployments.

tiles.label: Virtualization
tiles.says: Hypervisors carve hardware into isolated machines.
tiles.detail: Bare-metal hypervisors run many virtual machines with separate virtual networks. This consolidates hardware and allows strong isolation for legacy or regulated workloads.

tiles.label: Edge listeners
tiles.says: Listeners accept HTTP, TLS and raw TCP connections.
tiles.detail: Web servers terminate TLS and route requests by host and path. A single hardened entry point simplifies certificates and security reviews.

tiles.label: L4/L7 balancing
tiles.says: Balancers spread load and remove failed servers.
tiles.detail: Health-checked backends keep traffic away from unhealthy nodes. Failover through a floating address turns hardware faults into non-events for users.

tiles.label: API gateway
tiles.says: Gateways authenticate, limit and route every API call.
tiles.detail: Plugins enforce keys, tokens, rate limits and transformations centrally. Teams ship services faster because cross-cutting policy lives in one place.

tiles.label: Mesh mTLS
tiles.says: Sidecars encrypt and shape service-to-service traffic.
tiles.detail: A service mesh adds mutual TLS, retries and traffic splitting without changing application code. Canary releases and zero-trust networking become configuration.

tiles.label: SSO & tokens
tiles.says: Identity providers issue and verify signed tokens.
tiles.detail: OpenID Connect and SAML give users one login and give APIs verifiable claims. Access changes happen in one place instead of every application.

tiles.label: Secrets
tiles.says: Vaults issue short-lived secrets under strict policy.
tiles.detail: Policies, leases and audit logs replace passwords in config files. Breaches shrink in scope and compliance evidence is automatic.

tiles.label: Event streaming
tiles.says: Partitioned logs carry events between systems durably.
tiles.detail: Producers append, consumer groups scale reads and offsets allow replay. Systems decouple, so teams deploy independently and recover from failures.

tiles.label: Databases & cache
tiles.says: Relational stores persist truth; caches deliver speed.
tiles.detail: PostgreSQL gives transactions and replication, Redis gives sub-millisecond reads. Together they keep products correct and fast under load.

tiles.label: Metrics & alerts
tiles.says: Metrics measure; alerts wake the right person.
tiles.detail: Pull-based scraping, recording rules and alert routing turn raw numbers into service level signals. Outages are found by monitoring rather than by customers.

tiles.label: Logs & traces
tiles.says: Logs and traces explain what metrics only suggest.
tiles.detail: Label-indexed logs and distributed traces link a symptom to its cause. Mean time to resolve drops because evidence sits in one dashboard.

tiles.label: CI/CD & GitOps
tiles.says: Pipelines build, test, scan and promote every change.
tiles.detail: Automated stages and Git-driven deploys make releases routine and auditable. Faster feedback means smaller changes and fewer incidents.

tiles.label: IaC & config
tiles.says: Code defines infrastructure and converges it repeatably.
tiles.detail: Idempotent playbooks and declarative templates rebuild environments identically. Drift disappears and recovery becomes a command, not a project.

tiles.label: Managed services
tiles.says: Cloud services replace undifferentiated operations work.
tiles.detail: Managed DNS, load balancers, storage and queues scale on demand. The business pays for usage and spends engineering time on product.

tiles.label: Edge delivery
tiles.says: CDNs serve content close to users.
tiles.detail: Caching at the edge cuts latency and origin load, with private buckets reached through scoped origin access.

tiles.label: Automation glue
tiles.says: Python scripts connect every layer through APIs.
tiles.detail: Small, tested scripts automate reports, cleanups and integrations across clouds and clusters. Toil falls and knowledge becomes code.
